alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:7d9d5a1f-3.title: Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:7d9d5a1f-3.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE At Baseten, we’re looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive our most complex, cross-cutting infrastructure programs. This role will operate across all domains of AI infrastructure, from the GPUs up to the multi-cluster orchestration layer. This is an execution-first role. The work is less about owning a single system and more about imposing order on ambiguity: standing up the right structures, driving decisions to closure, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks across dozens of stakeholders. If you take satisfaction in turning a chaotic, half-defined initiative into a predictable, well-governed program, this role is for you. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own complex migrations end to end. Lead large-scale infrastructure migrations across teams and domains. This will involve scoping the work, sequencing dependencies, managing risk, and driving them to completion without surprises. - Drive process across infrastructure. Establish and run the operating rhythms that keep programs healthy: planning cadences, status reporting, decision logs, risk reviews, and escalation paths. Make the process light enough that teams adopt it and rigorous enough that it actually works. - Help managers build the right structures. Partner with engineering managers and leads to design the team structures, ownership boundaries, and working models a program needs to succeed. Spot gaps in accountability before they become problems. - Own follow-ups relentlessly. Be the person who tracks every open item, owns the action register, and closes loops. Drive decisions and unblockers to resolution rather than letting them drift. - Create clarity from ambiguity. Take loosely defined goals and turn them into scoped, sequenced, resourced plans with clear owners and measurable milestones. - Manage risk and dependencies. Maintain a clear-eyed view of cross-team dependencies and risks; surface them early, drive mitigation, and keep leadership informed with honest, signal-rich updates. - Communicate up, down, and across. Translate between deeply technical teams and senior leadership. Run effective program reviews and write the kind of crisp status that lets busy people make fast decisions. REQUIREMENTS - 3+ years of technical program management experience, with a track record of delivering large, cross-team infrastructure or platform programs. - Demonstrated ownership of complex migrations or comparable multi-domain initiatives from inception through completion. - Strong execution discipline: you build the structures, cadences, and tracking that keep programs on the rails, and you hold the line on follow-through. - Comfort operating across multiple infrastructure domains. You don't need to be the deepest expert in any one, but you can engage credibly with engineers on compute, storage, networking, and data. - Proven ability to influence without authority, aligning teams and managers who don't report to you around shared plans and commitments. - Excellent written and verbal communication; you can make complex, technical programs legible to any audience. - A bias toward closure: you're uncomfortable with open loops and you drive things to done. NICE-TO-HAVE - Experience designing team structures or operating models alongside engineering leadership. - Experience with AI models, their use, and how they operate at the infrastructure level. - Background in or ex

Light video editing and content/format suggestions are a bonus but not the primary focus. to TikTok and Instagram • Convert podcast audio/text content for distribution on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and Audible • Maintain a consistent posting schedule and content calendar across all platforms Strategy & Growth • Recommend platform-specific strategies to grow subscribers and followers • Identify which platforms best suit different content types (e.g. short-form vs. long-form) • Monitor engagement and follower growth, providing regular performance summaries • Suggest improvements to content format, pacing, or presentation style Light Editing & Content Support (Bonus) • Basic video editing/clean-up of AI-avatar-generated episodes (HeyGen output) • Light graphic design for thumbnails, cover art, or promotional posts • Suggestions on improving the AI avatar presentation or overall production quality Requirements • Proven experience managing social media accounts and content calendars across multiple platforms (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube) • Experience repurposing long-form video into short-form content (Reels/Shorts/TikToks) • Familiarity with podcast distribution platforms (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Audible) • Strong understanding of platform-specific best practices and content trends • Excellent written English communication skills • Self-starter who can work independently with minimal oversight • Comfortable working with a client who is new to content creation and open to guidance Nice to Have • Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Canva, Premiere Rush, or similar) • Graphic design skills (Canva, Photoshop) • Experience with AI avatar tools such as HeyGen • Interest or background in faith-based, Christian, or values-driven content Tools & Platforms YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Spotify for Podcasters, Apple Podcasts Connect, Audible, HeyGen, and a content scheduling/calendar tool (e.g. Later, Buffer, or Meta Business Suite). Client Context The client is a US-based individual (Florida) who self-funds and produces the podcast independently. He has a limited budget and is looking for a candidate who can largely run distribution and strategy with minimal hand-holding, while remaining open to feedback and recommendations on improving content quality.

brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:3d0a0f88-814e-4674-a.title: Production Technician, 2nd Shift
brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:3d0a0f88-814e-4674-a.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. ABOUT THIS ROLE: As a Production Technician, you will play a hands-on role in bringing our products to life. With foundational skills already in place, you will perform detailed work, such as precision soldering, troubleshooting and collaborating with other teams to improve processes. This role begins on second shift (~3:00 PM–11:30 PM), with an anticipated transition to day shift within 4–6 months; shift assignment is subject to change based on business needs. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Product Assembly: - Fabricate and assemble components using schematics, diagrams and written instructions. - Read and/or create assembly work instructions, repair manuals and liaise with other departments to assemble products. - Perform micro-soldering, rework and reflow tasks. - Build prototype models based on technical guidelines. - Manage and install cables, wiring, splicing as needed. - Testing, Troubleshooting & Quality Assurance: - Inspect, analyze and troubleshoot systems and equipment. - Run tests and interpret results to make effective recommendations. - Diagnose and repair electronic and mechanical issues in prototypes or production models. - Determine material or replacement needs and a logical method for repair; take appropriate action to meet those needs and make repairs. - Repair, install and inspect electronics or electronic systems as directed through verbal or written instructions, diagrams, drawings or specifications. - Create or adapt parts as needed to make repairs and improve the performance of various electronics. - Ensure all builds meet established quality standards and specifications. - Perform safety checks to ensure design plans are feasible in various conditions. - Documentation: - Maintain accurate records of assembly processes, testing results, repairs and any modifications. - Write reports, and follow safety regulations and preventative maintenance plans. - Provide feedback on design or process improvements to enhance production efficiency. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: - Work closely with engineers and other team members to meet production goals. - Follow and contribute to safety protocols and workplace cleanliness. QUALIFICATIONS: - Associate degree in avionics, electronics, or a similar field; or equivalent relevant experience. - Ability to use hand and power tools. - Ability to use diagnostic tools. - Ability to understand and utilize work instructions and technical manuals. - Strong analytical skills and ability to work independently. - Ability to lift up to 49lbs. - Ability to sit, stand or be on your feet for extended periods of time. PREFERRED SKILLS: - Ability to troubleshoot electrical and mechanical repairs. - Experience fixing and maintaining drones and knowledge of different drone systems. - Basic knowledge of drone operation and maintenance. - Understanding of quality control processes and documentation. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:8e549046-bbe.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f6ba222d-e257-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MEP Design Engineer based in Netherlands. As an MEP Design Engineer, you’ll contribute to the technical development of a major AI data center project with significant power and infrastructure requirements. You’ll take responsibility for designing and reviewing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems supporting critical infrastructure. Your work will directly influence reliability, energy efficiency, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance across the facility. You’ll collaborate with technology, IT infrastructure, suppliers, and engineering partners to integrate complex systems into a cohesive design. The role covers everything from electrical distribution and cooling to fire protection, ventilation, and building management systems. You’ll also contribute to technical specifications, tender processes, vendor evaluations, and the ongoing development of the Basis of Design. This is an opportunity to work on advanced infrastructure in a technically demanding, international, and fully remote environment. Develop and review electrical distribution systems , including medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, diesel generators, and battery energy storage systems (BESS). Design and review cooling and ventilation systems , including chillers, dry coolers, water towers, and liquid cooling solutions where applicable. Coordinate modular facility architecture and ensure effective integration with mechanical, electrical, and plumbing infrastructure. Develop gas fire suppression, ventilation, and OT/IT integration systems, including BMS and DCIM solutions. Review technical and design documentation provided by suppliers, contractors, and engineering partners, identifying risks, inconsistencies, and potential design gaps. Ensure MEP solutions comply with applicable regulatory, safety, reliability, and energy-efficiency requirements. Prepare, maintain, and update the Basis of Design and associated technical specifications. Participate in tender processes and evaluate technical proposals from vendors supplying generators, UPS systems, chillers, switchgear, and other critical equipment. Coordinate closely with IT Infrastructure teams to align power and cooling requirements with IT deployment needs. Support technical coordination throughout the project lifecycle and contribute to resolving design and integration challenges. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in MEP design for critical infrastructure or heavy-industry facilities, such as data centers, industrial plants, energy facilities, telecommunications infrastructure, or comparable environments. Demonstrated experience designing cooling and ventilation systems ; strong conventional HVAC experience is sufficient. Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems used in critical infrastructure environments. Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit , and relevant engineering calculation or design software. Ability to review multidisciplinary technical documentation and identify engineering risks, discrepancies, and integration issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical design solutions. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with suppliers, engineering partners, IT teams, and other stakeholders. English proficiency sufficient to work effectively with international teams and prepare or review technical project documentation. Experience with Tier III/IV facilities is an advantage. Knowledge of direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems or high-density computing environments is a plus. Familiarity with EU or Polish electrical, building, and fire safety regulations is desirable. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fce5f6e0-5cd5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Real Estate Paralegal based in the United States. This fully remote role offers the opportunity to play a key part in accelerating commercial real estate transactions from diligence through closing. You’ll manage a nationwide deal pipeline while coordinating documentation, execution, and closing activities across multiple jurisdictions. The role combines legal research, transaction coordination, document review, and meticulous attention to detail. You’ll work closely with legal and real estate professionals to keep complex transactions organized and moving forward. The position is well suited to an experienced paralegal who enjoys ownership, collaboration, and a fast-moving transactional environment. You’ll also have the opportunity to work across specialized real estate assets, including renewable energy and wireless infrastructure. Working remotely from your home office, you’ll have meaningful responsibility and visibility across the transaction lifecycle. Manage a pipeline of commercial real estate transactions across the United States, maintaining accurate closing checklists, trackers, deadlines, and transaction status updates. Prepare, organize, and coordinate the execution of transaction and closing packages, ensuring documentation is complete and accurate. Conduct real estate due diligence by reviewing leases, title commitments, plats, surveys, site inspection materials, and other transaction-related documentation. Assist with retrieving and organizing required documentation and information needed to advance transactions toward closing. Draft and review legal descriptions and support other transactional documentation as needed. Coordinate effectively across multiple jurisdictions and transaction stakeholders to identify outstanding items and help accelerate closings. Maintain a high level of accuracy, organization, confidentiality, and professionalism while managing multiple transactions simultaneously. Requirements: 4–8 years of experience as a commercial real estate paralegal, preferably within a mid-sized or large law firm or similarly sophisticated real estate environment. Bachelor’s degree required. Strong understanding of commercial real estate transactions, due diligence, closing processes, and multi-jurisdictional practices. Experience with solar or wind ground leases and/or wireless leases is a plus.
